name: Hand-drawn Notes
tagline: code-video's handdrawn default: warm paper, wobbly ink lines, one coral, Caveat annotations — nothing else is coloured.

motion.direction: code-video `handdrawn`. Warm paper, ink `#2b2a28` at 2–2.5 px wobbly lines, a serif (Fraunces) for headings and Caveat for annotations; the ONE colour is coral `ter` — nothing else is coloured. Lines are drawn, not faded (`draw` entrance, left to right); a `strikeLine` scribbles out the wrong idea; `chips` as hand-boxed labels; `imageCard`s taped at a tilt with a Caveat caption; `counter`s written like a tally. Sentence case, generous margins, one idea per frame, the board accumulates then clears per chapter.
